faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: All Your Queries Answered.
faq.a1: EliteFiT is a premium men's fitness brand specialising in strength training, physique sculpting, and high-intensity conditioning. We combine expert coaching, personalised programming, and a powerful community to help you unlock your strongest self.
faq.a2: Absolutely. We offer a free trial session for all new members. Come in, meet your coach, experience the facility, and see why thousands of men have transformed their lives with EliteFiT — no commitment required.

faq.a4: Monday to Friday: 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM. Saturday and Sunday: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM. Premium members enjoy 24/7 access to our facilities — so your schedule is never an excuse.

healthDashboard.label: Smart Health Tracking
healthDashboard.title: Your body. Live. Real-time.
healthDashboard.subtitle: Connect your Apple Watch, Garmin, or phone and track every workout, rep, and heartbeat — synced directly to your EliteFiT profile and coach dashboard.
healthDashboard.activityDesc: 20+ different workout types, and Meditation too. With new sessions added every week.
healthDashboard.timerDesc: 5 to 45 minutes, with or without equipment. And you can even filter by trainer, music, or meditation theme.
healthDashboard.heartTitle: Put your heart into it. Literally.
healthDashboard.heartDesc: Keep an eye on your heart rate, check the status of your rings, and watch your celebrations come alive. It's all right there on the screen, so you can stay motivated throughout your workout without looking down at your wrist. Eyes forward. Progress ahead.
healthDashboard.liveSync: Live sync active — data sent to your coach dashboard via webhook
healthDashboard.connectDesc: Follow the steps below to sync your health data with EliteFiT in real-time.
healthDashboard.step1: Open the EliteFiT app on your device and enable Health permissions
healthDashboard.step2: Make sure Bluetooth is enabled and your device is nearby
healthDashboard.step3: Tap "Connect Now" — your live data will sync to your coach dashboard instantly
healthDashboard.deviceConnectedDesc: Your health data is now syncing live to your EliteFiT coach dashboard.
